Root-caused to two compounding gaps in the mobile media query: (1) .s82's mobile column-reflow never set align-items:stretch, so its content child sized to its own nowrap derivation content instead of the available width; (2) .s13's own second grid child (an unclassed wrapper div holding each item's full prompt+solution content) never got min-width:0, so as a CSS grid item it refused to shrink below its widest nowrap descendant (a long two-column \begin{array}{ll} proof row, .s92/.s93) even though .s13 itself correctly collapsed to a single 1fr column.
